From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Uncertain if inherited or borrowed from Latin vapōrem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /vaˈpo.re/
  • Rhymes: -ore
  • Hyphenation: va‧pó‧re

Noun

[edit]

vapore m (plural vapori)

  1. steam
  2. vapour, especially water vapour
  3. ellipsis of nave a vapore (“steamship”)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • evaporare
  • vaporare
  • vaporazione
  • vaporetto
  • vaporizzare
  • vaporoso

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Albanian: vapor
  • → Greek: βαπόρι (vapóri)
  • → Ottoman Turkish: واپور (vapor, vapur)
    • Turkish: vapur, bapur, bafur, bapır, babır, papur, papor (dialectal)
    • → Armenian: վափոր (vapʻor), վափուր (vapʻur), պաֆոռ (pafoṙ), փաֆոռ (pʻafoṙ)
    • → Georgian: ვაფორი (vapori) — Chveneburi
    • → Laz: ვაფური (vapuri), ვაფოჲი (vapoyi) — Lome
    • → Northern Kurdish: vapûr, wapor, papor
    • → South Levantine Arabic: بابور (bābōr, “ship”)

Anagrams

[edit]
  • parevo, pavore, povera

Latin

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

vapōre

  1. ablative singular of vapor

Middle English

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

vapore

  1. alternative form of vapouren
